announcement.quote: On October 31, 2024, Goldman Sachs Private Middle Market Credit LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ PMMC ”), entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “ Merger Agreement ”) with Pantheon Silver Holdings LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ Pantheon ”), and Silver Merger Sub LLC

deals.notes: PMMC is an LLC regulated as a BDC whose 8-K cover page lists no securities registered under Section 12(b) and no exchange (Title of each class / Trading Symbol / Name of each exchange on which registered: None, N/A, N/A); members, not stockholders, vote. The acquirer is Pantheon Silver Holdings LLC through its merger subsidiary Silver Merger Sub LLC (merging into PMMC, PMMC surviving); Pantheon's listing status is not stated. Later 8-Ks (from 2024-12-26) are filed under the name Silver Capital Holdings LLC for the same CIK, but the compact excerpts do not state a completion, so no outcome beyond not_a_listed_pair is recorded.
